title: HLSE Scan Summary
description: The final line emitted by `hlse_core --json scan <dir>` — a rollup of all findings in the scanned directory tree.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict. Use this field to identify verdicts that predate a new detector capability and should be re-scanned.

threats.description: Number of findings with score >= 40 (ALERT or above).

max_severity.description: Highest severity (0–4) across all findings in this scan. 0 when threats=0. Use max_severity >= 3 as a numeric BLOCK/ISOLATE gate on a single summary-line consumer.

gate_hits.description: Number of findings that crossed the fail threshold (triggers non-zero exit code).

fail_threshold.description: Score threshold used to determine gate_hits (default 60; overridable with --fail-above).

asset_classes.description: Count of distinct asset classes detected (cloud, code, infrastructure, …).

blast_radius.description: Highest-priority asset class label summarising combined exposure (e.g. 'cloud-infrastructure').

immediate_action.description: One-line response directive for the highest-severity finding class. Present when threats > 0.

blind_spot.description: What the scan cannot detect. Present when threats = 0.

dirs_unreadable.description: Directories that existed but could not be opened during the walk. Emitted only when non-zero: a summary with threats = 0 and a non-zero dirs_unreadable does not cover the whole tree.

mode.description: Scan mode — present only for `scan --git-history`, whose summary counts commits instead of files.

commits_scanned.description: Number of commits examined — present only in git-history mode, in place of files_scanned.
